# Redstrike benchmark scorecard

The public, versioned, reproducible scorecard: recall (what we catch), precision (whether what we report is real), cost efficiency (mean $ per verified finding), and reproducibility (variance across epochs). Capability without a measured precision + cost + reproducibility number proves nothing; this is that number.

Baselines are committed deliberately (the floor to beat); `benchmark/results/` is gitignored scratch. A live score is an operator workflow (see `RUNBOOK.md`); CI only runs `--selftest`.
